title: One’s observance in another’s house
literal_meaning: Entering someone else’s house and observing the Tuesday fast.
meaning_odia: ଅନ୍ୟର ଘରେ ପଶି ମଙ୍ଗଳବାର ଓଷା କରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଏହି କଥାରେ ଅଛି। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ ନିଜର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ବା ଆୟୋଜନକୁ ଅନ୍ୟର ଜାଗାରେ ନେଇ ବସାଇବା ଉପରେ ଏହା ଏକ ଟିପ୍ପଣୀ। କାହାର ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ହେଲା, ଅନୁମତି ଥିଲା କି ନାହିଁ, କିମ୍ବା କେଉଁ ପୂଜାବିଧି ହେଲା—ମୂଳ କଥା ସେସବୁ କହୁନାହିଁ।
explanation: The pointed detail is the location: the observance takes place after entering somebody else’s home. Our editorial reading applies that mismatch to carrying one’s own arrangements into another person’s space as though it were one’s own. The line leaves the practical circumstances unstated.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A guest begins reorganising the host’s room for a personal activity without first discussing it. The host recalls the saying about conducting one’s observance in another’s house.
cultural_context: Tuesday names the occasion and osha names a religious observance involving a vow or fast. The proverb’s compact scene depends on the contrast between that personal activity and another person’s household, without detailing the ritual.

witnesses.locator: Page28, second item beginning ପର ଘରେ ପଶି.
